description: Preset auto-aprendido por Claude (haiku-4.5) desde un video. Ad de testimonio UGC para suplemento herbal de drenaje linfático. Abre con hook visual dramático (anatomía 3D inflamada) + ingrediente natural (trébol rojo), luego pivota a testimonios reales de mujeres mostrando el producto y resultados en timeline (72h, 14 días). Fuerza: autenticidad UGC + urgenci

category.description: La narradora es una mujer que cuenta su propia historia.

format.description: Persona hablando a cámara (selfie/talking-head amateur). Idealmente con Veo Talking Head.

visualStyle.promptTemplate: UGC-style testimonial video for herbal wellness product. Mix of: (1) dramatic 3D medical anatomy visualization with red/orange inflammation overlay and neon green text callouts for hook, (2) close-up product shots of dark glass herbal tincture bottle with white/green label, (3) authentic real-woman testimonials in home bathroom/bedroom settings with natural or warm lighting, shot on smartphone. Women of diverse ethnicities, ages 25-50, speaking directly to camera with genuine expressions progressing from concern to relief. Neon green text overlays with bold claims about timeline results (14 days, 72 hours). Aspect ratio 9:16 vertical.
visualStyle.negativePrompt: avoid: overly polished studio lighting, professional actors, artificial backgrounds, medical disclaimers visible, skeptical expressions, product not visible in testimonial scenes, horizontal orientation, watermarks, low-quality phone footage artifacts
